answer_1.quote: We evaluate five editorial tasks: Headline Generation (HEAD), Summarization (SUMM), Continuation of Writing (CONT), Expansion of Writing (EXPA), and Style Refinement (REFI) ...
answer_1.outputs: Generated headlines, summaries, continued articles, expanded articles, and refined text in Chinese.

answer_2.quote: To get the final performances of the LLM on the four types of evaluations, we adopt accuracy as the evaluation metric for MCQs while implementing GPT-4 based evaluation metrics for SAQs.

answer_3.quote: Two GPT-4 based evaluation protocols for journalistic writing proficiency and safety compliance are developed and validated by human annotation.
methods: GPT-4 based evaluation protocol for short answer questions

answer_4.quote: Human evaluations are following the same annotation instructions ... we involve three human annotators to manually assess the outputs generated by these models. For journalistic writing proficiency, we prepare 200 annotation samples ... annotators have a high interannotator agreement with a Krippendorff's alpha value of 0.9188. For safety adherence, we prepare 600 annotation samples ... three annotators highly agree with each other with Krippendorff's α of 0.8542.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators score each model output on the four journalistic writing facets (Language Fluency, Logical Coherence, Style Alignment, Instruction Fulfillment) and on the six safety facets (Civil Language, Bias and Discrimination, Personal Privacy, Social Harm, Journalistic Ethics, Illegal Activities) according to detailed annotation instructions.
